projects.name: Noto script fonts
projects.selection: All unhinted/ttf/*-Regular.ttf builds except family names containing Test. Regular static builds only; other styles, variable-only families and experimental test fonts are not surveyed.

projects.name: Noto CJK
projects.selection: Sans and Serif Regular OTF builds for JP, KR, SC, TC and HK.

projects.name: Noto Color Emoji
projects.selection: 2D/fonts/NotoColorEmoji.ttf; scalar cmaps only, no emoji sequence claims.

projects.name: GNU Unifont
projects.selection: Standard and Upper OpenType builds. No JP, T-source, sample or CSUR variants. Other upstream formats and plane-specific source HEX files are outside this binary survey.

projects.name: DejaVu
projects.license: Bitstream Vera and Arev licenses; DejaVu changes public domain (see release LICENSE)
projects.selection: Every TTF in official dejavu-fonts-ttf-2.37 archive, all styles.
projects.license_evidence: dejavu-fonts-ttf-2.37/LICENSE inside the locked release archive; font name table license URLs also point to the project license page.

projects.name: GNU FreeFont
projects.selection: Every TTF in official freefont-ttf-20120503.zip, all styles. Historical released binaries, not current development sources.
projects.license_evidence: freefont-20120503/README (Licensing section) and COPYING inside the locked release ZIP.

projects.name: Jigmo
projects.selection: All TTF files in official Jigmo-20250912.zip (Jigmo, Jigmo2, Jigmo3).

projects.name: BabelStone Han
projects.selection: All TTF files in versioned BabelStoneHan-16.0.3.zip; original Arphic Public License, not the later noncommercial license.

projects.name: Egyptology Extended
projects.selection: fonts/EgyptologyExtended.ttf; partial Extended-A coverage advertised by the author; measured counts are authoritative.

projects.name: Seal Sans
projects.selection: SealSans-Regular_v1.otf. License declaration is embedded in font name table ID 13 (GNU Affero General Public License v3.0); its ID 14 LICENSE link is currently missing. Outlines are provisional per author.
projects.license_evidence: Embedded name table 13 verified directly; do not infer license from the README or an unrelated repository.

projects.name: Charis
projects.selection: Every TTF in the official Charis-7.000.zip release. Evaluated as a Latin/phonetic coverage candidate even if it fills no baseline gap.

projects.name: Fairfax HD
projects.selection: Main FairfaxHD.ttf only; no Hax, Pona, Pula, SM or NoCJK variants. Candidate for Unicode 18 Latin Extended-G additions.

projects.name: Tangut Yinchuan
projects.selection: Standard TangutYinchuan.ttf, inverse variant excluded. Free download/use; modification, sale and for-profit redistribution require express permission.

projects.name: Apple-distributed macOS fonts
projects.selection: All installed TTF/OTF/TTC/OTC files under /System/Library/Fonts, including Supplemental; every collection face. Excludes LastResort (diagnostic coverage). Does not imply every downloadable Apple font is installed. Not all fonts distributed by Apple were designed by Apple; embedded license evidence is retained per face.

projects.name: Typdex Jigmo U18 experimental
projects.selection: Three locally compiled Typdex Jigmo U18 TTFs. Preserves published Jigmo 20250912; adds only nonempty GlyphWiki SVGs for Unicode 18 East Asian targets and explicit original Tangut gaps. Partial experimental update; see experiments/jigmo/build-report.json.

excluded.reason: Last Resort diagnostic fallback maps all Unicode scalar values to representative block symbols; never count as glyph support.
